question.prompt: What is the smallest prime number dividing the sum \(3^{11}+5^{13}?\)

solutions.explanation: A product of odd integers is odd, so both \(3^{11}\) and \(5^{13}\) are odd. The sum of two odd integers is even, which means \(2\) divides \(3^{11}+5^{13}\). Since \(2\) is the smallest prime number, the requested prime is \(\boxed{2}\), choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
solutions.title: Check whether the sum is even
